description: Géoschématique de l'assainissement - Bassins versants is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
